caseStudy.title: Yaaxa
caseStudy.lead: A short-video social app for iOS that connects people through the videos they share: record with AR avatars and effects, add filters, stickers and music, film duets side by side, and find matches in the feed.

brief.title: The brief
text: Yaaxa wanted people to meet through short videos instead of profiles: record something, share it, and let the app find people who match.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the native iOS app in Swift with RxSwift and SnapKit.
Integrated DeepAR for AR avatars and effects, including an API for avatars.
Built filters, stickers, emoji, watermark and music on videos.
Built duet videos side by side, Discover, comments and the inbox.
Used Firebase Auth, Firestore, Storage and Messaging, with Facebook and Google sign-in.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: A video-first social app with AR recording, duets and matching.
